instructions: Peel the 2 bananas and break them into chunks.
Peel the 2 oranges and pull them apart into segments.
Pour the 2 cups coconut milk into a blender, then add the bananas, the orange segments and 4 cups of the spinach.
Add the 3 cups frozen pineapple and the 4 tsp chia seeds on top.
Blend on high for 1 to 2 minutes, until it's smooth and bright green with no flecks of leaf left.
Pour into 4 tall glasses and serve right away.
method_notes: All three read versions blend spinach with a banana and a sweet fruit in a dairy free milk, and all say the fruit hides the taste of the greens. Natasha's Kitchen (the lead) uses coconut milk, a banana, an orange, 2 cups fresh spinach and 1 1/2 cups frozen pineapple for two, with chia seeds as an option, and loads the blender liquid first. Love and Lemons uses frozen spinach, almond milk and a little almond butter, and Downshiftology uses an apple and a bit of avocado. This one doubles the lead for four glasses.
